overall: The AG found the Board's notice listing "Renewal of Fall Soil Permits" lacked the specificity required when the chair anticipated discussing particular permits. Violation found; the AG declined to rescind the Selectmen's action and closed the matter with guidance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the October 12, 2010 notice item 'Renewal of Fall Soil Permits' was too vague to show which applicants, projects, or locations would be considered.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board's notice for its October 12, 2010 meeting did not meet the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: In the future, the Board is required to comply with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25. This includes taking the steps necessary to provide sufficient detail in meeting notices such that members of the public are able to understand specifically which issues and locations will be discussed by the Board.
remedy_passage: In the future, the Board is required to comply with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
